newsitem.title: UK: GKN sells Germany Super Lynx for 100 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: GKN sells Germany Super Lynx for 100 mln stg.

text.p: British defence and engineering group GKN Plc said on Monday its Westland unit had confirmed a contract with the German government for the purchase of seven Super Lynx helicopters in a deal worth some 100 million stg.
The Mk88A version to be supplied to Germany is parallel to an existing British Royal Navy helicopter, capable of both anti-submarine warfare and anti-surface vessel operations.
The company said that production was due to start in 1997, with first deliveries in 1999.

GKN Westland is also discussing with the Germany Navy an upgrade of its 17 existing Sea Lynx Mk88 helicopters to the new Mk 88A standard, it added in the statement, giving no further financial details.
